notes.title: New patch: achievements & bug fixed
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/d1d4316185f0e87c5bc8f54e0dffdad0c977ac8d.png

Hi Gatekeepers,

A new patch for KINGDOM of the DEAD is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the changelog:


Fixed issue with 3 Steam achievements not registering ("Paths of Gory", "Blood on the Tracks", and "Misty Mountain Drop")
Fixed issue with bat boss area damage being randomly reduced 
Fixed issue with 2nd and 3rd save slots showing wrong check for endless mode
Map tweaks & visual adjustments
Thank you for your patience!

See you in the abyss.

- Camilla from HOOK

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Endless mode, Achievements, and more.
notes.notes:
Gatekeepers, it’s time to survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/b294087dd5985ddef4803756f685e58a13e4eb60.png

A new UPDATE for KINGDOM of the DEAD is now available for download, which includes a new mode, achievements, and additional improvements.

Here’s the changelog:


New Endless mode has been implemented. Survive against as many enemies as you can!
Added Endless mode map.
Added 33 new unlockable achievements.
Controller support is now available.
Added several animation improvements.
Several minor bugs were fixed.
We hope you will jump back into the darkness of KINGDOM of the DEAD to show us your skills and records!

See you in the abyss.

- Camilla from HOOK

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD - release date change
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/993d61c7bb8ca94c7480513e4a2da90f8964ec88.png

Hi agentis,

To give you the best experience possible in KINGDOM of the DEAD, we have decided to slightly postpone the release of the game to February 10th, 2022. This will allow our one-dev-army to polish all the necessary details.

In the meantime, we remind you to add KotD to your wishlist on Steam while waiting to be able to explore its pits, deep wells and crypts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

Thank you for your instrumental support,

HOOK Team

If you want to find out more about the world of KINGDOM of the DEAD and stay up to date, remember to join the conversation on our Twitter and Reddit.

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD Publisher and Release Date
notes.notes:
The gates of the underworld are about to open.

[previewyoutube=eIHluef2ET4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce that KINGDOM of the DEAD will be coming to Steam on 26th January 2022, thanks to the work of one-dev-army DIRIGO Games and supported by the newborn publisher HOOK, a new division from the Digital Bros Group focused on indie games.
 
As a new and (not so) big happy family, we want to thank you for the amazing support over the past few weeks and the interest shown in KotD, which we hope you will enjoy in its final form (yes, much more awaits you).

Save the date, wishlist now and spread the word. 
It’s almost time to remind Death where it belongs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

Join the conversation on Twitter and Reddit

DIRIGO Games & HOOK Team
